title: Finite-free evaluation transpose is invertible
statement: Let C be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], R to S a finite free map of commutative ring sheaves, E the actual additive sheafified scalar extension, and (T, ε) its universal left derived pair [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Fix normalized closed tensor-Hom models AR, AS, MR, MS [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] and natural tensor comparisons κ, μ satisfying the pure-tensor formula and K-flat counit square of [lem-sf-ringed-finite-free-tensor-data]. Then the evaluation transpose μ inverse followed by T(evaluation) is a natural isomorphism T H_R(P,Q) to H_S(TP,TQ), for arbitrary unbounded P,Q.

source.place: Tag 08J9, label lemma-internal-hom: derived tensor-Hom adjunction. The finite-free change-of-rings specialization and its evaluation normalization are the auxiliary assertion here, not a verbatim assertion of that tag.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-ringed-finite-free-hom-coordinates] to obtain a_H, a_Q, β and the equation on each basis inclusion. The functor G = RHom_R(P,-) is a right adjoint by [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], so it preserves products. Compose G applied to the biproduct-to-product isomorphism, its product comparison, and the inverse product-to-biproduct isomorphism. This constructs γ : RHom_R(P,Q^d) ≅ RHom_R(P,Q)^d, with j-th projection G(pr_j). Set b = β followed by G(a_Q inverse) and γ. The basis-inclusion equation gives ι_i a_H U(c) b = G(ι_i) γ, since a_Q followed by its inverse cancels. Projecting to j gives G(ι_i pr_j), which is δ_ij identity: right adjoints preserve zero morphisms and all functors preserve identities. Biproduct extensionality proves a_H U(c) b is identity, hence U(c) is invertible. This includes the empty family for d=0.

Ordinary restriction is faithful and exact, hence reflects isomorphisms. Its derived homology comparison shows that every cohomology map of the comparison is invertible. Apply DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to obtain invertibility of the comparison itself.

Naturality of evaluation in both variables, naturality of mu, and injectivity of tensor-Hom transposition prove naturality of the displayed components. Their invertibility assembles a natural isomorphism by NatIso.ofComponents; its components are the required transposes by construction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JA; the importing module proves right-adjoint product preservation, the coordinate matrix calculation, homology conservativity, and naturality by tensor-Hom transposition.

        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J S))

            WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J S)
      (μ : AR.tensor ⋙ T ≅ T.prod T ⋙ AS.tensor)
    (hκ : (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)

    (hcomp : (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P)

          (μ.inv.app ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op P, Q), P) ≫
